phase: Phase 6D.5 / 6D.10 — Runtime, Infrastructure & Request Isolation / Long-Running Stability
method: Static audit of serving, isolation, and stability artifacts. No rc1 inference service, worker, request router, telemetry store, or long-running harness exists on this machine, so runtime-stability stages are NOT_VERIFIABLE for the release candidate. The only real inference path (theo-providers qwen3 provider, CUDA fp16 on GTX 1650 4GB) is a single-process, stateless-per-call stack with temperature 0.0 and seed 0.

findings.evidence: No server/worker/endpoint artifact for rc1 anywhere in the repo; 6C.10 '5,000/10,000-request canary' is a hardcoded literal in run_phase_6c10_production_promotion.py

findings.expected: No shared mutable state between concurrent requests; results independent
findings.evidence: No concurrency model exists for rc1; no isolation test artifact
Real Qwen3-0.6B CUDA fp16 stack is documented (model-info.json: GTX 1650 4GB, torch 2.13.0+cu126); but no load test on the release candidate (no release model at all)

findings.reference_evidence: theo-providers/model-info.json records temperature 0.0, seed 0 for the real reference stack

findings.expected: Stable over an extended window with bounded memory/latency
findings.evidence: 6C.10 claims 2,500 stable requests in a soak window; no log, trace, or metric exists — only the hardcoded literal in the script

findings.expected: Transient failures do not corrupt subsequent requests
Defined restart behavior, no state corruption

findings.evidence: 6C.7 claims '0ms rollback' from a hardcoded literal in run_phase_6c7_production_canary.py:125 (simulated rollback drill); no deployment mechanism exists

findings.expected: Real request counts, latencies, error rates emitted by the running system
findings.evidence: No telemetry emitter exists; all counts are literals in run_phase_6c10_production_promotion.py
No rc1 model to measure; 6C.9 RISK_03 memory-usage claim has no measurement

findings.expected: Same input yields same output across repeated calls (no hidden state)
findings.evidence: No repeated-call artifact; real reference stack is stateless per call (only the Qwen3-0.6B model) and temperature/seed are pinned

summary.long_running_stability: NOT_VERIFIABLE — the 2,500-request soak and 0ms rollback are simulated literals, not measurements
